method: Replace [LOCATION] with a country or region. The prompt requests 4:5; the three reviewed source images are approximately 2:3 at 1024×1536, 1024×1536 and 1080×1620. The landmarks and travel layout are present, but neighboring key labels do not guarantee four distinct cities: Sydney is repeated in the Australian example and the Algeria output lacks the small landmark sign.

variants.label: Keyboard-key travel diorama
variants.promptText:
[LOCATION]:
Create a macro photograph of a mechanical keyboard, with one key popped open like a hinged jewelry-box lid, revealing a miniature isometric diorama inside dedicated to [LOCATION].
Automatically determine and include, based on [LOCATION]:
The single most iconic landmark or monument of [LOCATION], rendered as a detailed miniature paper-craft/claymation-style model
Flora native or visually associated with [LOCATION]'s climate (e.g. palms for tropical/desert regions, cypress or olive trees for Mediterranean, pine for alpine, etc.), placed around the landmark
A wooden signpost near the landmark labeled with the landmark's name
A small figure of a traveler in a backpack and sunhat, standing near the signpost as if sightseeing
A tiny sailboat or boat floating on a strip of stylized blue water in the foreground, if [LOCATION] is coastal or has a notable waterway — otherwise omit the water/boat and extend the stone/ground surface instead
Stone steps, terraces, or pathways leading up to the landmark, styled to match its real architecture
The diorama should use a soft, warm beige/cream/sandstone color palette with golden-hour directional lighting and shallow depth of field. The main key is labeled "[LOCATION]" in bold black text along its front edge.
Surround the main key with blurred neighboring keyboard keys, each labeled with the names of 4 other major cities within [LOCATION] (automatically selected as the most well-known cities of that country/region).
Style: hyper-detailed miniature diorama, photorealistic keyboard texture, whimsical tilt-shift travel aesthetic, consistent with a travel-themed keyboard series.
aspect ratio 4:5

purpose: Create a miniature travel diorama from a country or region.
summary: A keyboard key opens like a box to reveal a small location-specific travel scene with a landmark, flora, traveler and water when relevant.
title: Keyboard-key travel diorama

variables.name: Location
variables.value: A country or region to turn into a miniature travel world.
